Dr. Aparna Rajesh Atmakuri (also known in academic registries as Aparna Manikonda) is an Associate Professor in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) at Keshav Memorial Engineering College (KMEC). She earned her Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering from Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi, India. She is the recipient of the prestigious International Women Researcher Award in Cybersecurity (Academic Excellence Awards). Her pioneering research includes the formulation of the Role Key Homomorphic Encryption Algorithm (RKHEA) for continuous, tamper-proof user monitoring in cloud environments without compromising data privacy. With over 17 research publications spanning indexed international journals and conferences (including IEEE, MECS, and AIP), her scholastic work focuses on homomorphic encryption, cloud cybersecurity architectures, biometric authentication, and cryptographic protocol verification. She actively guides undergraduate research initiatives and departmental security labs.
